Definition: Governed component that reads Chirality instruction-root materials and produces deterministic, source-grounded prompt context for the SDK-backed runtime path.
Release-managed governance and agents/AGENT_<persona>.md content that is read authority and must not be mutated by ordinary execution.
Project-root context kept separate from the instruction root, treated as contextual prompt material, not governance.
Hashed inputs reflecting persona content, governance preface, mode, tool/policy posture, MCP server versions, and subagent policy version.
Instruction-root governance material included as a section of the composed prompt.
The configured set of tools described in prompt context and accepted from the runtime/options layer rather than reconstructed.
UI-to-canonical-agent mapping (e.g. HELP->HELP_HUMAN) defined in docs/TYPES.md Section 3.4.
Prompt content that must not imply autonomous professional approval, certification, signing, sealing, issuing, or external validation.
PRD-derived typed-failure token for missing persona resolution, subject to REF-006 hash warning.
Flag in _REFERENCES.md REF-006 indicating docs/PRD.md content requires confirmation against an accepted snapshot.
SDK option set to [] so shipped options do not inherit ambient settings; owned outside this deliverable.
Runtime enforcement mechanism (with denied tools, hooks, path policy) that enforces permissions instead of prompt text.
